title: Chris's family and Ben's own brass band years
summary: Chris's son Jack and widow are mentioned and no other brother played music. Ben played with Chris only in the brass band, down at Deer Range.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Is Chris's wife still living? Last time I heard from him she's living. He has a son too. I've never met him. You've met his son, haven't you? Yeah, I met his son. Yeah. That's his son. One called Jack.
Jack. That's right. Jack. I saw him but I don't know him.
Don't be his uncle. Yeah. Yeah. He'd be a friend. He's working downtown somewhere and she could play.
He's working. Well, while I think of it, did you have any other brothers that played any music? No one else in the family then that played music? No.
Did you ever play in Chris's band? What's called?
Not in the string band? No. Can't tell that a lot. Oh, indeed. About how long did you play together in the brass band?
Oh, we played together pretty good wives in the brass band, but seven or eight children.
That was down in the country, down at the Deer Range. That's right. You got that right.
We used to left them at Deer Range and go over to send soap and paper read and things.
Is that on the other side of the river? No, since Hopi's on this side of the river. This side, yeah that's what I mean.
